name: Chou no You ni Mai ~Dance Like a Butterfly~
original_name: 蝶のように舞い ~Dance like a Butterfly~
source:
Follow the life and choices of Mikami Rei, a 17-year-old trans youth, as she goes through the early steps of her transition.

[From [url=http://suvidriel.itch.io/dance-like-a-butterfly]itch.io[/url]]

Created for [url=http://itch.io/jam/jamforleelah]#JamForLeelah[/url].
